Container.Name: smugmug-cli
Container.Overview:
Backs up a photo library to SmugMug on a schedule. Every photo and video under the Photos path goes into a private album for the day it was taken (Backup/2014/07/2014-07-12), dated from its EXIF or video metadata, its file name, or its modified time.
After the first run, unchanged files are only checked by size and modified time (never re-read), so later runs are cheap on disks and CPU, and a run over an unchanged library makes no requests to SmugMug. Identical copies are uploaded once, edited files replace their image, RAW files are uploaded as JPEGs rendered from their embedded preview unless you have SmugMug Source, and nothing is ever deleted from SmugMug.
You need a SmugMug API key and secret (https://api.smugmug.com/api/developer/apply) and an access token and secret for your account; running smugmug-cli auth on any computer gets you the token. The container runs at low CPU and I/O priority. See the README for exclude patterns and the .smugmugignore file.
Container.Requires: A SmugMug account, API key and access token

Config.Name: Photos
Config.Description: The folder to back up (mounted read-only). To back up only some folders, add more paths under /photos (e.g. /photos/family).

Config.Name: Cache
Config.Description: What has been uploaded already. Must persist: it's what lets later runs skip unchanged files.

Config.Name: SmugMug access token
Config.Description: Run smugmug-cli auth on any computer to get one

Config.Name: SmugMug folder
Config.Description: SmugMug folder the year/month/day albums go in (created private)

Config.Name: Interval
Config.Description: Time between the end of one backup and the start of the next, e.g. 30m, 6h, 1d

Config.Name: Exclude
Config.Description: Paths to leave out, comma-separated, in .gitignore syntax relative to /photos (e.g. old_backup/, **/Screenshots/)

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Optional config.toml for settings not offered here (read threads, RAW handling, Live Photo videos)

Config.Name: CPU priority
Config.Description: nice level (0-19); empty for normal priority

Config.Name: I/O priority class
Config.Description: ionice class: 3 = idle, 2 = best effort; empty for normal priority
